title: Language-agnostic retry profiles, idempotency keying, and retryable-error taxonomy for SDKs
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Define language-agnostic retry/backoff profiles, a simple idempotency keying convention, and a concise taxonomy of retryable error classes for Redwood client libraries (Python, TypeScript, Go). The goal is to provide sensible defaults that reduce accidental duplicates, make streaming and long-running requests robust, and produce consistent observability across SDKs without adding cognitive overhead for application developers.
acceptance_criteria: A documented set of 3 recommended retry profiles (conservative, balanced, aggressive) with explicit backoff parameters and when to use each
A single idempotency key format and guidance for when SDKs should auto-generate keys vs require caller-supplied keys
An error taxonomy (transient-network, transient-service-429/capacity, idempotency-safe-client-timeout, non-retryable) with examples and mapping to HTTP/gRPC statuses
SDKs (Python/TS/Go) implement the default profiles and keying behavior behind a single configuration flag and expose extensibility hooks
Unit + integration tests cover streaming resume behavior and duplicate-suppression for idempotent operations
Telemetry events emitted for retries, fallback to lower-tier models, and idempotency key collisions
implementation_notes: Python: provide RetryProfile dataclass, default instances, and an optional RetryController passed to ClientConfig; use urllib3/retries-like semantics but with Redwood-specific status mapping
TypeScript: expose retry presets as exported constants and a builder function for custom policies; ensure browser and node parity for backoff timers
Go: implement interface RetryPolicy with methods ShouldRetry(err) and NextBackoff(attempt); use context.Context for cancellation and preserve idempotency keys across retries
Streaming: for resumable streams, attach idempotency_key to initial open-frame; server returns resume_token; client should only retry non-terminal stream errors if resume_token is available
Telemetry: emit 'retry.attempt' with fields {profile,attempt,reason,backoff_ms} and 'idempotency.key_generated' when SDK generates a key
updates: 2025-01-15 - Ticket created by Aisha Khan: initial scope and high-level goals
2025-01-22 - Engineering kickoff with SDK leads (Mei, Rafael, Sofia): agreed on three-profile model and single key GUIDv4-based format with optional caller override

2025-01-30 - Spike complete: measured latency tail on balanced vs aggressive profiles for typical chat workload (see Drive results). Aggressive reduces median latency by ~8% but increases duplicate risk on server-side timeouts.
2025-02-03 - Decision: default policy will be 'balanced'. Aggressive profile marked as opt-in and documented with trade-offs. Conservative reserved for high-cost or side-effectful operations.
2025-02-05 - Design review feedback from PM Liam O'Connor: add explicit guidance for rate-limit (429) handling and a grace interval before switching to quota-fallback routes.
2025-02-07 - Security review note: idempotency keys should not contain user PII; ensure SDKs avoid echoing prompt contents in generated keys. Security sign-off not required for this change.

2025-02-10 - Implementation: Python PR opened; TypeScript and Go PRs in draft. Integration tests for stream resume still pending. Next: finalize HTTP status -> taxonomy mapping and add telemetry counters for 'retry.success_after_n'
